text: Miniature Suids (Japanese: , Tainī Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family. They are smaller than Little Suids. They can be found at level 12-13 in Noctilum.
Mindstorm is one of L's two Signature Arts in . Cross learns this art after completing the affinity mission L's Conundrum.

three enemies during The Celeste Three]] Mission Exclusive Enemies are special enemies in . They are unique and appear exclusively during a related Mission. Most are also mission enemies, as they must be defeated to complete said mission. They can only be defeated once per playthrough, there are similar to the Quest Exclusive Enemies in . Due to the way the plot progresses, all Story Exclusive Enemies and Bosses from Chapter 3 onwards are also Mission Exclusive.

Miniature Femina Suids (Japanese: , Tainī Femina Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family. They are smaller than Little Suids. They can be found at level 13-15 in Noctilum, in Goblin's Narrow.

Miniature Adseculas (Japanese: , Tainī Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 1-7 at East Gate Plain, Seaswept Base, or Starfall Basin in Primordia at night.
Middle Hushflood (Japanese: , Shinkan Taiga Chūryūku) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of Breakwater Narrow and north of FN Site 204.

Mischievous Mephites (Japanese: , Misuchifu Mepitesu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 12 at Whale's Nostril in Noctilum. Several can be found accompanying Gerhardt, the Lone and Proud.
Miranium Request is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Miranium Researcher in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Mission Enemies are Mission-related enemies in . They must be defeated in order to complete a specific mission. Mission Enemies can be normal minor enemies as well as Tyrants. Defeating one or several specific enemies may be required in order to complete a Basic Mission. These requests may be ordered by an NPC, a Division, an Arms Manufacturer, etc. Some Mission Enemies, such as Nemeses, are Mission Exclusive; they are one-of-a-kind and appear exclusively during a related Mission. They do not respawn after the objective set requesting their defeat has been completed.

The Millstone Ridge (Japanese: , Ishiusu Ganban) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, east of Dead Man's Gulch, and must be visited during Chapter 6. It is inhabited purely by Tainted. Like all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("The Hidden Millstone Ridge").

Minion Potamuses (Japanese: , Kurōnī Hippo, Croney Hippo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Potamus family, and can be found at level 20 at the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum. During the day, they can be found in the spring itself, while at night they are gathered around the Dopang Caravan.

Mighty Mia (Japanese: , Mīa no Junan, Mia's Suffering) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered by approaching the Leaning Ring in Oblivia after the prerequisites have been met. It is the third of five Missions that culminate in Mia being able to be recruited.
Minor Sabulas (Japanese: , Mainā Sabueru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sabula family. They can be found at level 22-23 at Suncatch Ravine in Noctilum.

Mesgen, the Fairweathered (Japanese: , Hiyori no Mesugen) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Potamus family. It can be found at level 28 near Sayram Lake in Primordia. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Mesgen, the Fairweathered.

The Mimeosome Maintenance Center (Japanese: , Mentenansu Sentā) is a landmark in . It is located in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, on the south side of Division Drive. It provides a service analogous to a hospital for BLADEs, whose mimeosomes are interred in pods for recovery here when injured. The Mimeosome Maintenance Center also functions as an actual medical facility for patients with fully biological bodies, such as Al, a non-mimeosome human (in the ) who lived in New Los Angeles when it was still the habitat of the White Whale. Since New Los Angeles crashed to Mira, the facility also functions as a medical facility for xenoforms such as Ni Zain, a Wrothian who is admit

Mikulas, the Keystone (Japanese: , Kanameishi no Mikurāshu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Falsaxum family. It can be found at level 34 at West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum, submerged half in the ground. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Mikulas, the Keystone.
Mika (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. She is a member of the Outfitters Division.

The Milligan Supply Base (Japanese: , Mirigan Hokyūkichi) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion stronghold located in Oblivia, on the Big Arch north of the Aaroy Plain and west of King's Falls.

Mesa Fortress (Japanese: , Mesa no Yōsai) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion base located in southwestern Oblivia, at the southwestern end of the large bridge spanning the Yawning Giant and southeast of Stoyanov Trail. The FN Site 303 is located here.

Metal Blattas (Japanese: , Metaru Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 11-12 in Headwater Cavern in Primordia. Five of them must be defeated during Mission C.

Min'barac (Japanese: , Minboiton) is an Orphean NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. During The Bug Whisperer, he is found at Primordia's Shadow Beach BC. After this mission, he can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship.
Mia Grows Up (Japanese: , Mīa no Kōkō, Mia's Filial Piety) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received near Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Mirage Scopes (Japanese: , Sōgan no Shinsekai) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in caves in Primordia, including Silent Mire's cave, the Beasts' Lair, Headwater Cavern and Castaway Cavern. Nine are needed for Talk of the Town.

Meteo Eaters (Japanese: , Meteoītā) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular near FN Site 118 in the early morning, the time can be set nearby at North Janpath BC.

Mk. IX Hypercoolers (Japanese: , Haipādoraibā IX) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular near FN Site 215. Five are needed for Supplies Surprise.
Mirrored Peacocks (Japanese: , Gūjakku) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular the zone south of FN Site 210.

Mizaria Celeries (Japanese: , Mizaria Serori) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular at Lake Ciel in the early morning. Six are needed for the Squad Mission Nursery Bed Boost of the BLADE Mission No.6.

Missile Wirings (Japanese: , Misairu Waiyaringu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular in the South Cinderdunes or in the northwestern regions of Sylvalum Waters. Five are required for It's-a Mia!

Mirage Blattas (Japanese: , Mirāju Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 34 under the spiked structure at Needle Rock Sandsea south of FN Site 411 and east of FN Site 413 in Sylvalum.
Mirage Mortifoles (Japanese: , Mirāju Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family, and can be found at level 41-50 south of Everwhelm Falls in Noctilum

The Milsaadi (ミルサード, Mirusādo) are a race of beings in . They are alien assassins with high skills in melee combat. In fact, they can use melee gravity attacks, and ranged beam attacks. They are members of the Ganglion coalition, primarily found in Sylvalum and Cauldros. The only appendage that can be targeted is the hood, which can drop a certain material based on variant. Members of the blue variant can drop Blue Milsaadi Hoods, while members of the red variant can drop Red Milsaadi Hoods. Following Void's return, the Milsaadi remained loyal to him, and migrated to Volitaris for the final battle against New Los Angeles's forces. After Mira's complete destruction from the Dematerialization
Mighty Viragos (Japanese: , Maiti Toruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Virago family, and can be found at level 45-46 at Northern Searoad in Sylvalum.
Mirage Vivohasts (Japanese: , Mirāju Borunte) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vivohast family, and can be found at level 33-34 on the Nopon Highroad in Noctilum.
Mirror Blattas (Japanese: , Mirā Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 51-70 in Cauldros's Bestial Utopia.
Mist Germivores (Japanese: , Misuto Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 31-40 at FN Site 509 in Cauldros.

Mimeosomes (Japanese: , Blue Blood; English dub: ), or Mims (Japanese: , B.B.; English dub: ) for short, are artificial bodies in . The player is first made aware of their existence in Chapter 5. They typically have distinct rings on the iris, which can be used to differentiate them from actual lifeforms. However, they can also choose to have more natural-looking eyes.

Milsaadi Assassins (Japanese: , Mirusādo Asashin) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 51-60 in Cauldros's Kitsune Stronghold, Ganglion Antropolis and Mount M'gando.

Milsaadi Astrans (Japanese: , Mirusādo Asutoraru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 60 in the lower cave of Sylvalum's Cavernous Abyss, dropping in when the party approaches the crashed helicopter; and at level 59 in Quay Hollows.

Milsaadi Champions (Japanese: , Mirusādo Kyarion) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 60 in the lower cave of Sylvalum's Cavernous Abyss, dropping in when the party approaches the crashed helicopter.

Milsaadi Executioners (Japanese: , Mirusādo Mādā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 44 at Hilal Stronghold, level 49 at Badr Stronghold, level 47 at Behemoth's Shadows, and level 42 in the Den of the Dead in Sylvalum. They may jump down from the ceiling.
Milsaadi Fighters (Japanese: , Mirusādo Faitā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 31-40 in Cauldros's Kw'arah Cloister.
Milsaadi Heralds (Japanese: , Mirusādo Ansemu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 51-60 in Sylvalum's Anvil Sandplain.
Milsaadi Hitmen (Japanese: , Mirusādo Hittoman) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 50 atop the highest building in Sylvalum's Badr Stronghold.

Milsaadi Hunters (Japanese: , Mirusādo Hantā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros, near Sunset Falls, Kw'arah Cloister or O'rrh Sim Keep.
Milsaadi Protobattlers (Japanese: , Mirusādo Puroto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 51-60 in Primordia, near FN Site 110.
Milsaadi Rampagers (Japanese: , Mirusādo Maddo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros, northwest of FN Site 512 .
Milsaadi Robbers (Japanese: , Mirusādo Sutīrā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 51-60 at FN Site 110 in Primordia.

Milsaadi Savages (Japanese: , Mirusādo Kirā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 51-60 in Cauldros's Kitsune Stronghold, Ganglion Antropolis and Mount M'gando.
Milsaadi Specters (Japanese: , Mirusādo Supekutā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 59 in Quay Hollows in Sylvalum.
Metal Xeno Chains are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained after defeating Ryyz.

The Mezzo Chimera (Japanese: , Media Kimaera) is a Story Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Chimera family, and is fought at level 49 inside the Lifehold Core during Chapter 12. It can assist, along with the Major or the Minor Chimeras, the Queen Chimera summoned by Lao if the fight lasts long. None of these Chimeras are registered in the Enemy Index, except Lao as well as the Soldier Chimeras from the previous battle.

The Milsaadi Corroders (Japanese: , Korōdo Mirusādo) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and are fought at level 20 at the West Janpath Plain in Primordia during the Affinity Mission A False Hope.
Mindscape is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Winged Viper at rank 9.
Mighty Muscle is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Striker at rank 7. Cross, Lin, L, Gwin, Nagi, Frye and H.B. can use this skill.

Missile Barrel is a Ranged Art in . It is a Multigun exclusive art, and it can be obtained after completing Yelv's final affinity mission. It deals Electric damage and inflicts Shock, dealing bonus damage if an Aura is active.
Mikkal is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Mimiru is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Nopon and can be found at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia during the day.

Mia is Missing! (Japanese: , Mīa no Saigo, Mia's Last) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Mia in the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros. Near the back of the Antropolis, hanging a left down a side passageway will lead to the trailer that Mia is locked in (X: 55.38; Y: 146.52). Said trailer is marked with a yellow square and a white dot on the map. The trailer is guarded by a high level Definian Clone. A cutscene will trigger upon approaching it.

Miranium for Fun and Profit is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from May May and the primary destination is the Ma-non Ship. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the normal mission The Membership.
Midnight Inspiration is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located behind the Repenta Diner in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles, between Frye and Cross at late night.

Metal Puges (Japanese: , Metaru Berude) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 20 Puges and are fought during Unknown Assailant. Three of them are fought near Oblivia's Lake Basel. If route B of the mission is chosen, three more are fought at the entrance to Sylvalum's Banshee Cave.
Milly (Japanese: , Mirī) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Human, and can be found at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia during the day.
Miranium Exchange is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the May May and the primary destination is the Ma-non Ship.

The Mimeosome Left Arm is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from a piece of White Whale wreckage on Oblivia's Great Washington Isle during the Affinity Mission Arms and the Man.

The Mimeosome Left Leg is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found in Oblivia's East Ibra Ravine after the Affinity Mission Arms and the Man. It's one of two Mimeosome legs needed before accepting Yelv's Partner.

The Mimeosome Right Leg is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found on the northwest shore of Oblivia's Lake Basel after the Affinity Mission Arms and the Man. Both the right and left legs must be found to unlock the affinity mission Yelv's Partner.

Mist Milsaadi (Japanese: , Misuto Mirusādo) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion soldiers, and can be found at level 41-49 on Northern Searoad in Sylvalum during White Lifehold. They are part of a group of Milsaadi against whom the party must defend for three minutes, and will respawn during that time.

Milsaadi Fates (Japanese: , Mirusādo Fati) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion soldiers. They can be found at levels 41 – 49 on Northern Searoad in Sylvalum during White Lifehold, and are fought in two successive battles.

Milsaadi Finis are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion soldiers, and can be found at level 41-49 on Northern Searoad in Sylvalum during White Lifehold. They are part of a group of Milsaadi against whom the party must defend for three minutes, and will respawn during that time.

Meredith Heavy (Female) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a female mannequin wearing a complete set of Meredith & Co. Heavy Wear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Entrepreneurial Spirit. Mincing Millesaurs is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Primordia. It is a request to defeat two Everlasting Millesaurs.

Misery of Moimoi! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Moimoi and the primary destination is the Industrial District. This quest leads into Muimui's Meltdown, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.

Mission A is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Yelv on the North Founders Street in the Commercial District. It is received automatically when Meeting Yelv is accepted.

Mission B is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Yelv on the North Founders Street in the Commercial District. It is received automatically when Meeting Yelv is accepted.

Mission C is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Yelv on the North Founders Street in the Commercial District. It is received automatically when Meeting Yelv is accepted.
Meteor Launcher! is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Alexa and Cross at any time of day.
Millesaur Dung are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millesaurs.

Millepod Ice Rocks are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Hartmut, the Calamity, or for 198 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are one of the components of X, XV, and XX Chimeroid Slayer and Slayer.CHIMEROID augments.

The Milsaadi Lieutenant (Japanese: , Baisu Mirusādo) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Milsaadi Ganglion, and he must be defeated within five minutes at level 40 at Lotus Keep Building Site in Noctilum during Slovity's Revenge.
Millesaur A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black millesaur variant. It can be obtained from Fernando, the Immovable in Noctilum.
Millesaur B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a white millesaur variant. It can be obtained from Luciel, the Eternal in Primordia.
Millepod A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an orange millepod variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Shuravas, the Enraged in Noctilum.
Millepod B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown millepod variant. It can be obtained from Hartmut, the Calamity in Oblivia.
Milsaadi Male A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts red-clothed male Milsaadi. It can be obtained from silver drops from Sharnaak, the Technician in Cauldros.
Milsaadi Male B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a a blue-clothed male Milsaadi. It can be obtained from silver drops from Badul, the One-Eyed in Sylvalum.
Milsaadi Female A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a red-clothed female Milsaadi. It can be obtained from silver drops from Chantai, the Insect Maiden in Cauldros.
Milsaadi Female B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue-clothed female Milsaadi. It can be obtained from silver drops from Lyla, the Lustrous in Sylvalum.

Meredith Light (Male) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male mannequin wearing a complete set of Meredith & Co. Light Wear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission A Proper Chopper. Meredith Medium (Male) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male mannequin wearing a complete set of Meredith & Co. Medium Wear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Data Probe Revolution. Miramobile is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Professor B's time machine car, with Veven standing on top. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Mystery Man.

Mimetic Menace is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Germivores. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Mischief Makers is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.18, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty-four Jaculs. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
The Mimeosome Head is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is found upon completion of Yelv's Partner.
The Mimeosome Torso is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is found upon completion of Yelv's Partner.

The Milsaadi Guard (Japanese: , Gādo Mirusādo) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Milsaadi Ganglion and can be found at level 55 in the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros during Definian Downfall, by the rocky gate before the room with the pool of water. It drops the First Barrier Key required to drop the forcefield.
Mia's Adventure Bodywear is Medium Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Mia's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
The Minigun is an arm weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from creed revolver type Galdrs, Petramands or Vigents.
Meteors are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Spine-Cannon/E-Bubble/B-Bomb types Qmoevas or female Milsaadi.
Mia's Adventure Glove L is Medium Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Mia's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Mia's Adventure Glove R is Medium Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Mia's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Mia's Adventure Footwear is Medium Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Mia's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.

※ After this quest is completed, a Defence Force Soldier may offer another quest. (See The Lost Pendant). He also gives Arachno Silk Fundraising and its follow-up, A Thank You. Missing in Action (Japanese: , Tandokukōdō no Heishi, The AWOL Soldier) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in Warehouse 2 in Tephra Cave. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.
Mia's Comm Device is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be found during Adventure!
Meteor Lance (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Megalance.
Mighty Beat (Japanese: , Maitibīto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Shield Hammer. Rex flips the weapon over before slamming the head of the hammer onto the ground.
Mighty Ball (Japanese: , Maitibōru) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Bitball. In the , it is also one of Rex's arts when using Bunnie.

The Mid-ship Walkway Door (Japanese: , Chūō Kanpan Renrakuguchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. It is a stairwell between the Living Quarters and Olno's Mess Hall. There are no enemies here.
Midorl Bridge (Japanese: , Midubaru-bashi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. It connects Alba Cavanich and the Upper Level.
The Mine Elevator (Japanese: , Saikutsuba Erebētā-mae) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Mine No. 2 Entrance (Japanese: , Dai-2 Saikutsuba - Iriguchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, at the end of a low valley north-east of Midorl Bridge. It is the entrance to the Brionac Occupied Zone. There are no enemies here except during Insurgent Investigations.
Minnet Terrace (Japanese: , Mīnesu Dankyū) is a location in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, uphill to the southeast from Eight-Rock Skip and above the Farlaine Central Pools.
Milama Viewpoint (Japanese: , Tenbō-chi Mira Mā) is a Landmark in . It is located at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium.

The Middle Worm-Ridden Cave (Japanese: , Chūsō: Mushibami no Kaidō) is a landmark in . It is located on the Mid Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys, beyond the Cenotaph Bridge. From here a small tunnel leads to the Secret Area Subterranean Lake Galantia, and directly ahead is Penitents' Spring. A side passage blocked by cobwebs leads through to the Chamber of Offering.
* Mid Level (Spirit Crucible Elpys) * Mid Level (World Tree)

Mk. VII Arek (Japanese: , Dainanasedai no Areisutā) is one of the Superbosses in . It is a Unique Monster and a Sovereign; it can be found at level 114 on Lv. 4, Megrez of the World Tree, accompanied by a Grandum Sovereign and Valta Sovereign, after the party reaches the First Low Orbit Station. Mk. VII Arek can summon Gerolf Sovereigns, who can in turn summon Familion Sovereigns. It can be sealed with a dark Blade Combo to prevent it. The three enemies spawn together when using the tombstone.

The Mizar Thoroughfare (Japanese: , Rakia Kan'i Setsuzokuro) is a location in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree, between the 7th Perimeter Center Floor and Mizar, Elevator #5. There is a Treasure Trove and two Collection Points here.

Mizar, Elevator #8 (Japanese: , Rakia Dai-8 Erebētā) is a landmark in . It is an elevator located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Lv. 2, Mizar: Lower Deck and the Waste Store. There are no enemies here.
Mizar, Elevator #20 (Japanese: , Rakia Dai-20 Erebētā) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between the Sky Bridge and the Roadway to 7th Perimeter.

Mizar, Elevator #5 (Japanese: , Rakia Dai-5 Erebētā) is a landmark in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree between the Mizar Thoroughfare and the 7th Perimeter Defense Post. There are no enemies here.
